description: Source code for BenchmarkRunnerPadMM class, which benchmarks padded matrix multiplication (pad_mm) to generate training data for AutoHeuristic. Contains methods for creating inputs, running benchmarks, and generating tensor dimensions.

classes.name: BenchmarkRunnerPadMM
classes.description: A benchmarking class for pad_mm, used to generate training data with AutoHeuristic.

methods.name: create_input
methods.description: Generates input parameters for the benchmark, including tensor dimensions and transposition flags.

methods.name: run_benchmark
methods.description: Executes the benchmark with specified tensor dimensions and transposition options, compiling and running matrix multiplication.

methods.name: get_random_dim
methods.description: Generates a random tensor dimension, aligned or unaligned based on probability.

methods.name: is_aligned
methods.description: Checks if a dimension is aligned to a specified size.

methods.name: get_m_k_n
methods.description: Generates tensor dimensions (m, k, n) that fit in memory and meet alignment criteria.

methods.name: prepadded
methods.description: Randomly determines if a tensor is 'prepadded' based on probability.

methods.name: get_dtype
methods.description: Selects a random data type for tensors.
